name.Description: The name of the variable to manage. Note that variable names can be hierarchical using slashes (e.g. "prod-variables/hostname").

parent.Description: The name of the RuntimeConfig resource containing this variable.

project.Description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

update_time.Description: The timestamp in RFC3339 UTC "Zulu" format, accurate to nanoseconds, representing when the variable was last updated. Example: "2016-10-09T12:33:37.578138407Z".
